title: GenericContactType

Id.description: Product: ALL Description: Unique identifier for an Intuit entity.

Name.description: Product: ALL Description: Name of the generic contact type. For example, "GoogleChat" related contact info can have the Name, "ChatId".

Value.description: Product: ALL Description: Value of the contact type. For example, for a "GoogleChat" contact info, the Value may be the chat ID.

Type.description: Product: ALL Description: Type of contact. For example, "GoogleChat" or "Skype".

Default.description: Product: ALL Description: True if this is the default contact information.

Tag.description: Product: ALL Description: Descriptive tag associated with the contact information.

description: Product: ALL Description: Contact type other than email, phone, address. Examples: "Chat", "SkypeId", "FaceBook" etc.
